name: ModelColumnChanges
description: A collection of ModelColumnChange objects representing columns for which the data type was changed in the Excel data model.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Excel application. Read-only.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the specified object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns an Object that represents the parent object of the specified ModelColumnChanges object. Read-only.

properties.name: Count
properties.description: Returns a Long value that represents the number of ModelColumnChange objects in a ModelColumnChanges object. Read-only.

methods.name: Item
methods.description: Returns a single object from the ModelColumnChanges object.

parameters.name: Index
parameters.description: The index number for the object.
